description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of single channel elements, each preceded by a fill element of SBR data: the payloads follow no channel element, so they are reported and read by no one, but 1.6.5.2 item 1 takes any payload for implicit signaling: the stream is HE-AAC at 44100 Hz (decoders read none and decode AAC LC at 22050 Hz).
findings: 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC
12 raw data blocks hold SBR data that follows no single channel element, channel pair element or independently switched coupling channel element

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg cannot decode the frames ("SBR was found before the first channel element"), so it reports no sample rate.
skip.decode: ffmpeg reports that SBR was found before the first channel element, the condition the fixture tests.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 does not read the stream: its SBR payload follows no channel element, and its trace holds one raw data block.
